text: The fool doth think he is wise, but the wise man knows himself to be a fool.
zh: 愚者自以为智，智者自知其愚。
author: William Shakespeare

text: All the world's a stage, and all the men and women merely players.
zh: 整个世界是个舞台，男男女女不过是演员。
author: William Shakespeare

text: To be, or not to be: that is the question.
zh: 生存还是毁灭，这是一个值得思考的问题。
author: William Shakespeare

text: This above all: to thine own self be true.
zh: 最重要的是：对自己要诚实。
author: William Shakespeare

text: Cowards die many times before their deaths; the valiant never taste of death but once.
zh: 懦夫死前已死过多次，勇者一生只尝一次死亡。
author: William Shakespeare

text: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.
zh: 布鲁图斯，错不在星宿，而在我们自己。
author: William Shakespeare

text: Men at some time are masters of their fates.
zh: 人有时是命运的主宰。
author: William Shakespeare

text: Give every man thy ear, but few thy voice.
zh: 多听少说。
author: William Shakespeare

text: Brevity is the soul of wit.
zh: 简洁是智慧的灵魂。
author: William Shakespeare

text: There is nothing either good or bad, but thinking makes it so.
zh: 没有绝对的善恶，是人的思想使然。
author: William Shakespeare

text: What's done cannot be undone.
zh: 木已成舟，无法挽回。
author: William Shakespeare

text: Love looks not with the eyes, but with the mind.
zh: 爱情不用眼睛，而用心灵去看。
author: William Shakespeare

text: If music be the food of love, play on.
zh: 倘若音乐是爱情的食粮，那就奏下去吧。
author: William Shakespeare

text: Parting is such sweet sorrow.
zh: 离别是如此甜蜜的忧伤。
author: William Shakespeare

text: A rose by any other name would smell as sweet.
zh: 玫瑰即使换名，也依然芬芳。
author: William Shakespeare

text: Our doubts are traitors, and make us lose the good we oft might win.
zh: 我们的疑虑是叛徒，使我们错失本可赢得的好处。
author: William Shakespeare

text: What's past is prologue.
zh: 凡是过往，皆为序章。
author: William Shakespeare

text: When sorrows come, they come not single spies, but in battalions.
zh: 忧患来袭，从不是单个探子，而是成群大军。
author: William Shakespeare

text: Some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon them.
zh: 有人生而伟大，有人成就伟大，有人被赋予伟大。
author: William Shakespeare

text: Knowledge is power.
zh: 知识就是力量。
author: Francis Bacon

text: Reading maketh a full man; conference a ready man; and writing an exact man.
zh: 读书使人充实，讨论使人机智，写作使人精确。
author: Francis Bacon

text: Some books are to be tasted, others to be swallowed, and some few to be chewed and digested.
zh: 有的书浅尝辄止，有的囫囵吞下，少数须咀嚼消化。
author: Francis Bacon

text: A wise man will make more opportunities than he finds.
zh: 智者创造的机会多于他所发现的。
author: Francis Bacon

text: Studies serve for delight, for ornament, and for ability.
zh: 读书足以怡情，足以傅彩，足以长才。
author: Francis Bacon

text: Revenge is a kind of wild justice.
zh: 复仇是一种野生的公道。
author: Francis Bacon

text: Whoever is delighted in solitude is either a wild beast or a god.
zh: 喜独处者，非野兽即神灵。
author: Francis Bacon

text: Hope is a good breakfast, but it is a bad supper.
zh: 希望是美味的早餐，却是糟糕的晚餐。
author: Francis Bacon

text: The unexamined life is not worth living.
zh: 未经审视的人生不值得过。
author: Socrates

text: The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.
zh: 唯一的真智慧，是知道自己一无所知。
author: Socrates

text: Education is the kindling of a flame, not the filling of a vessel.
zh: 教育不是注满一桶水，而是点燃一把火。
author: Socrates

text: I know that I am intelligent, because I know that I know nothing.
zh: 我知我智，因我知我之无知。
author: Socrates

text: We can easily forgive a child who is afraid of the dark; the real tragedy of life is when men are afraid of the light.
zh: 我们易原谅怕黑的孩子；人生真正的悲剧，是成人害怕光明。
author: Plato

text: Wise men speak because they have something to say; fools because they have to say something.
zh: 智者发言因有话要说，愚者发言因不得不说。
author: Plato

text: The beginning is the most important part of the work.
zh: 开端是工作中最重要的部分。
author: Plato

text: Necessity is the mother of invention.
zh: 需要是发明之母。
author: Plato

text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
zh: 我们重复做什么，便是什么人。卓越不是一时之举，而是一种习惯。
author: Aristotle

text: Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.
zh: 认识自己是一切智慧的开端。
author: Aristotle

text: Quality is not an act, it is a habit.
zh: 品质不是一时之举，而是习惯。
author: Aristotle

text: Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet.
zh: 耐心苦涩，其果甘甜。
author: Aristotle

text: It is the mark of an educated mind to be able to entertain a thought without accepting it.
zh: 受过教育者的标志，是能容纳一种思想而不必接受它。
author: Aristotle

text: Friendship is a single soul dwelling in two bodies.
zh: 友谊是一个灵魂居于两个躯体。
author: Aristotle

text: Courage is the first of human qualities because it is the quality which guarantees the others.
zh: 勇气是人首要的品质，因为它保障其余品质。
author: Aristotle

text: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
zh: 只要不停下，走得慢也无妨。
author: Confucius

text: Learning without thought is labor lost; thought without learning is perilous.
zh: 学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆。
author: Confucius

text: What you do not want done to yourself, do not do to others.
zh: 己所不欲，勿施于人。
author: Confucius

text: The superior man is modest in his speech but exceeds in his actions.
zh: 君子讷于言而敏于行。
author: Confucius

text: Real knowledge is to know the extent of one's ignorance.
zh: 真正的知识，是知道自己无知的程度。
author: Confucius

text: Wherever you go, go with all your heart.
zh: 无论去何处，都要全心全意。
author: Confucius

text: To see what is right and not do it is want of courage.
zh: 见义不为，是无勇也。
author: Confucius

text: He who learns but does not think is lost; he who thinks but does not learn is in danger.
zh: 学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆。
author: Confucius

text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
zh: 千里之行，始于足下。
author: Lao Tzu

text: Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
zh: 自然从不匆忙，却成就万事。
author: Lao Tzu

text: Knowing others is intelligence; knowing yourself is true wisdom.
zh: 知人者智，自知者明。
author: Lao Tzu

text: The soft overcomes the hard; the gentle overcomes the rigid.
zh: 柔弱胜刚强。
author: Lao Tzu

text: When I let go of what I am, I become what I might be.
zh: 当我放下所是，便成为所能是。
author: Lao Tzu

text: Do the difficult things while they are easy and do the great things while they are small.
zh: 难事于易时为之，大事于小时为之。
author: Lao Tzu

text: Silence is a source of great strength.
zh: 沉默是巨大的力量之源。
author: Lao Tzu

text: The supreme art of war is to subdue the enemy without fighting.
zh: 不战而屈人之兵，善之善者也。
author: Sun Tzu

text: Know the enemy and know yourself, and you need not fear the result of a hundred battles.
zh: 知己知彼，百战不殆。
author: Sun Tzu

text: Victorious warriors win first and then go to war, while defeated warriors go to war first and then seek to win.
zh: 胜兵先胜而后求战，败兵先战而后求胜。
author: Sun Tzu

text: In the midst of chaos, there is also opportunity.
zh: 乱中亦有机。
author: Sun Tzu

text: Opportunities multiply as they are seized.
zh: 机遇在被把握时倍增。
author: Sun Tzu

text: You have power over your mind - not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
zh: 你掌控的是自己的心，而非外界之事。明白这点，你便有了力量。
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
zh: 你生活的幸福，取决于你思想的质量。
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
zh: 别再争论好人该是什么样，去做一个吧。
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: The soul becomes dyed with the color of its thoughts.
zh: 灵魂会染上思想的颜色。
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking.
zh: 幸福人生所需极少，全在于你自己的心境。
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: If it is not right, do not do it; if it is not true, do not say it.
zh: 若不正当，就别做；若不真实，就别说。
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: Confine yourself to the present.
zh: 把自己局限于当下。
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
zh: 阻碍行动者，反促进行动；挡路之物，反成道路。
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
zh: 我们不是寿命短，而是浪费了太多。
author: Seneca

text: Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
zh: 运气，是准备遇上机会时的产物。
author: Seneca

text: Every new beginning comes from some other beginning's end.
zh: 每一个新的开始，都源自另一个开始的终结。
author: Seneca

text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
zh: 我们常在想象中比在现实中受更多苦。
author: Seneca

text: He who is brave is free.
zh: 勇敢者即自由人。
author: Seneca

text: A gem cannot be polished without friction, nor a man perfected without trials.
zh: 宝石不经摩擦不能发光，人不经磨难不能完善。
author: Seneca

text: While we wait for life, life passes.
zh: 我们等待生活时，生活已悄然流逝。
author: Seneca

text: Gratitude is not only the greatest of virtues, but the parent of all others.
zh: 感恩不仅是最伟大的德性，更是其余一切之母。
author: Cicero

text: A room without books is like a body without a soul.
zh: 没有书的房间，犹如没有灵魂的躯体。
author: Cicero

text: While there's life, there's hope.
zh: 一息若存，希望不灭。
author: Cicero

text: The life of the dead is placed in the memory of the living.
zh: 逝者的生命，安放于生者的记忆中。
author: Cicero

text: Friendship improves happiness and abates misery, by doubling our joy and dividing our grief.
zh: 友谊增益欢乐、减轻悲哀，因它倍增喜悦、平分忧伤。
author: Cicero

text: Justice is the virtue of the soul which gives to each his due.
zh: 正义是灵魂之德，使人各得其所。
author: Cicero

text: What lies behind us and what lies before us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us.
zh: 与我们内心之物相比，身后与眼前的一切都微不足道。
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

text: The only person you are destined to become is the person you decide to be.
zh: 你注定成为的，是你决心成为的人。
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

text: Do not go where the path may lead, go instead where there is no path and leave a trail.
zh: 不要走别人铺好的路，去没有路的地方，留下足迹。
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

text: Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
zh: 我们最大的荣耀不在于从未跌倒，而在于每次跌倒后都能站起。
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

text: A hero is no braver than an ordinary man, but he is braver five minutes longer.
zh: 英雄并不比常人更勇敢，只是多勇敢了五分钟。
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

text: Write it on your heart that every day is the best day in the year.
zh: 把「每一天都是一年中最好的一天」写在心上。
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

text: For every minute you are angry you lose sixty seconds of happiness.
zh: 你每生气一分钟，就失去六十秒的幸福。
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

text: What you do speaks so loud that I cannot hear what you say.
zh: 你的行动如此响亮，让我听不见你的言语。
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

text: Self-reliance is the only road to true freedom.
zh: 自立是通往真正自由的唯一道路。
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

text: Nothing great was ever achieved without enthusiasm.
zh: 没有热情，便无一伟大成就。
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

text: The purpose of life is not to be happy. It is to be useful, to be honorable, to be compassionate.
zh: 生活的目的不是快乐，而是有所作为、有所尊荣、富有怜悯。
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

text: The mass of men lead lives of quiet desperation.
zh: 大多数人过着平静的绝望生活。
author: Henry David Thoreau

text: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined.
zh: 自信地朝梦想方向前进，去过你想象的生活。
author: Henry David Thoreau

text: Our life is frittered away by detail. Simplify, simplify.
zh: 生活被琐碎消耗。简化，再简化。
author: Henry David Thoreau

text: All good things are wild and free.
zh: 一切美好的事物都是野性而自由的。
author: Henry David Thoreau

text: Rather than love, than money, than fame, give me truth.
zh: 比起爱、金钱、名声，我更渴望真理。
author: Henry David Thoreau

text: Not until we are lost do we begin to understand ourselves.
zh: 直到迷失，我们才开始了解自己。
author: Henry David Thoreau

text: The price of anything is the amount of life you exchange for it.
zh: 任何事物的代价，是你用以交换的生命。
author: Henry David Thoreau

text: Live your beliefs and you can turn the world around.
zh: 践行你的信念，你便能改变世界。
author: Henry David Thoreau

text: Well done is better than well said.
zh: 做得好胜过说得好。
author: Benjamin Franklin

text: Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy, and wise.
zh: 早睡早起使人健康、富裕又聪明。
author: Benjamin Franklin

text: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
zh: 对知识的投资，回报最丰厚。
author: Benjamin Franklin

text: By failing to prepare, you are preparing to fail.
zh: 不准备，就是在准备失败。
author: Benjamin Franklin

text: Tell me and I forget. Teach me and I remember. Involve me and I learn.
zh: 告诉我，我会忘；教给我，我会记；让我参与，我才学会。
author: Benjamin Franklin

text: Lost time is never found again.
zh: 失去的时间再也找不回来。
author: Benjamin Franklin

text: Energy and persistence conquer all things.
zh: 精力与毅力能征服一切。
author: Benjamin Franklin

text: Honesty is the best policy.
zh: 诚实为上策。
author: Benjamin Franklin

text: Nearly all men can stand adversity, but if you want to test a man's character, give him power.
zh: 几乎所有人都经得起逆境，但要想考验一个人的品格，给他权力。
author: Abraham Lincoln

text: Whatever you are, be a good one.
zh: 无论你是什么，都要做个好样的。
author: Abraham Lincoln

text: I walk slowly, but I never walk backward.
zh: 我走得很慢，但从不后退。
author: Abraham Lincoln

text: Those who deny freedom to others deserve it not for themselves.
zh: 剥夺他人自由的人，自己也不配享有自由。
author: Abraham Lincoln

text: My great concern is not whether you have failed, but whether you are content with your failure.
zh: 我担心的不是你失败，而是你安于失败。
author: Abraham Lincoln

text: Character is like a tree and reputation is its shadow.
zh: 品格如树，声誉如影。
author: Abraham Lincoln

text: You cannot escape the responsibility of tomorrow by evading it today.
zh: 你无法用今天的逃避，躲开明天的责任。
author: Abraham Lincoln

text: Most folks are about as happy as they make up their minds to be.
zh: 大多数人的快乐程度，取决于他们下决心要快乐的程度。
author: Abraham Lincoln

text: Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
zh: 知道不够，必须运用；意愿不够，必须行动。
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

text: Whatever you can do or dream you can, begin it. Boldness has genius, power and magic in it.
zh: 无论你能做或梦想做何事，开始吧。胆识蕴含天赋、力量与魔力。
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

text: The person who does not read good books has no advantage over the person who cannot read them.
zh: 不读好书的人，并不比不识字的人占优势。
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

text: Treat people as if they were what they ought to be and you help them become what they are capable of being.
zh: 以他人应有的样子对待他，便助他成为所能成为的人。
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

text: As soon as you trust yourself, you will know how to live.
zh: 一旦你相信自己，便知如何生活。
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

text: Things which matter most must never be at the mercy of things which matter least.
zh: 最重要的事，绝不可受制于最不重要的事。
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

text: He who enjoys doing and enjoys what he has done is happy.
zh: 乐于做事并乐于所成之事者，是幸福的。
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

text: None are more hopelessly enslaved than those who falsely believe they are free.
zh: 最无可救药被奴役的，是误以为自己自由的人。
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

text: That which does not kill us makes us stronger.
zh: 凡杀不死我的，使我更强大。
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
zh: 知晓为何而活的人，几乎能承受任何如何。
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: Become who you are.
zh: 成为你自己。
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: When you gaze long into an abyss, the abyss also gazes into you.
zh: 当你长久凝视深渊，深渊也凝视着你。
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: The higher we soar, the smaller we appear to those who cannot fly.
zh: 我们飞得越高，在不能飞的人眼中就越小。
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: All truly great thoughts are conceived by walking.
zh: 一切真正伟大的思想，皆于行走中孕育。
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: Love your fate. It is your own.
zh: 热爱你的命运，那是你自己的。
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: The two most important days in your life are the day you are born and the day you find out why.
zh: 生命中最重要的两天，是你出生的那天，和你明白为何而生的那天。
author: Mark Twain

text: Twenty years from now you will be more disappointed by the things that you didn't do than by the ones you did do.
zh: 二十年后，让你失望的将不是你做过的事，而是你没做的事。
author: Mark Twain

text: Kindness is the language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
zh: 善良是聋者能听、盲者能见的语言。
author: Mark Twain

text: Courage is resistance to fear, mastery of fear - not absence of fear.
zh: 勇气是抵抗恐惧、驾驭恐惧，而非没有恐惧。
author: Mark Twain

text: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
zh: 领先的秘诀，在于开始。
author: Mark Twain

text: Worry is like a rocking chair: it gives you something to do but gets you nowhere.
zh: 忧虑如摇椅：让你有事做，却到不了任何地方。
author: Mark Twain

text: Keep away from people who try to belittle your ambitions.
zh: 远离那些试图贬低你志向的人。
author: Mark Twain

text: The best way to cheer yourself up is to try to cheer somebody else up.
zh: 让自己开心的最好方法，是设法让别人开心。
author: Mark Twain

text: Do the right thing. It will gratify some people and astonish the rest.
zh: 做正确的事。这会取悦一些人，让其余人惊讶。
author: Mark Twain

text: Be yourself; everyone else is already taken.
zh: 做你自己，因为别人都有人做了。
author: Oscar Wilde

text: To live is the rarest thing in the world. Most people exist, that is all.
zh: 生活是世上最稀罕的事，大多数人只是存在罢了。
author: Oscar Wilde

text: We are all in the gutter, but some of us are looking at the stars.
zh: 我们都在阴沟里，但有人仰望星空。
author: Oscar Wilde

text: The truth is rarely pure and never simple.
zh: 真相很少纯粹，也从不简单。
author: Oscar Wilde

text: To love oneself is the beginning of a lifelong romance.
zh: 爱自己，是一生浪漫之始。
author: Oscar Wilde

text: A friend is one who knows you and loves you just the same.
zh: 朋友是了解你、却依然爱你的人。
author: Oscar Wilde

text: Experience is simply the name we give our mistakes.
zh: 经验不过是我们给错误起的名字。
author: Oscar Wilde

text: Life is too important to be taken seriously.
zh: 生命太重要，不该被认真对待。
author: Oscar Wilde

text: Even the darkest night will end and the sun will rise.
zh: 最黑暗的夜晚终会结束，太阳终将升起。
author: Victor Hugo

text: Nothing is more powerful than an idea whose time has come.
zh: 没有什么比一个时机已到的思想更有力量。
author: Victor Hugo

text: To love another person is to see the face of God.
zh: 爱另一个人，就是看见神的面孔。
author: Victor Hugo

text: He who opens a school door, closes a prison.
zh: 开一扇校门，便关一扇牢门。
author: Victor Hugo

text: The greatest happiness of life is the conviction that we are loved.
zh: 生命最大的幸福，是确信自己被爱着。
author: Victor Hugo

text: Adversity makes men, and prosperity makes monsters.
zh: 逆境造人，顺境造怪物。
author: Victor Hugo

text: There is nothing like a dream to create the future.
zh: 没有什么比梦想更能创造未来。
author: Victor Hugo

text: Laughter is the sun that drives winter from the human face.
zh: 笑声是驱散人脸上的冬天的太阳。
author: Victor Hugo

text: Everyone thinks of changing the world, but no one thinks of changing himself.
zh: 人人都想改变世界，却没人想改变自己。
author: Leo Tolstoy

text: The two most powerful warriors are patience and time.
zh: 最有力的两位战士，是耐心与时间。
author: Leo Tolstoy

text: If you want to be happy, be.
zh: 若想快乐，就去快乐。
author: Leo Tolstoy

text: We can know only that we know nothing. And that is the highest degree of human wisdom.
zh: 我们仅知自己一无所知，而这正是人类智慧的最高境界。
author: Leo Tolstoy

text: The sole meaning of life is to serve humanity.
zh: 生命的唯一意义，在于服务人类。
author: Leo Tolstoy

text: Wrong does not cease to be wrong because the majority share in it.
zh: 错误不因多数人的参与而变成正确。
author: Leo Tolstoy

text: The secret of man's being is not only to live but to have something to live for.
zh: 人存在的秘密，不仅在于活着，更在于有所为而生。
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky

text: To live without hope is to cease to live.
zh: 没有希望地活着，便是停止生活。
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky

text: Beauty will save the world.
zh: 美将拯救世界。
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky

text: Taking a new step, uttering a new word, is what people fear most.
zh: 迈出一步、说出一个新词，是人们最恐惧的。
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky

text: We are all responsible for all.
zh: 我们为一切负责。
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky

text: The wound is the place where the light enters you.
zh: 伤口，是光照进你之处。
author: Rumi

text: What you seek is seeking you.
zh: 你所寻觅的，也在寻觅你。
author: Rumi

text: Raise your words, not your voice. It is rain that grows flowers, not thunder.
zh: 提高言语，而非嗓门。催开花朵的是雨，不是雷。
author: Rumi

text: Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
zh: 昨日我聪慧，故想改变世界；今日我智慧，故改变自己。
author: Rumi

text: Don't grieve. Anything you lose comes round in another form.
zh: 不要悲伤，你失去的一切会以另一种形式归来。
author: Rumi

text: The only lasting beauty is the beauty of the heart.
zh: 唯一恒久的美，是心灵之美。
author: Rumi

text: The mind is its own place, and in itself can make a heaven of hell, a hell of heaven.
zh: 心是其自有之地，能化地狱为天堂，化天堂为地狱。
author: John Milton

text: Better to reign in hell than serve in heaven.
zh: 宁在地狱为王，不在天堂为奴。
author: John Milton

text: They also serve who only stand and wait.
zh: 那些伫立等候的人，也在服务。
author: John Milton

text: A good book is the precious lifeblood of a master spirit.
zh: 好书是大师精神的宝贵血脉。
author: John Milton

text: To see a world in a grain of sand, and a heaven in a wild flower.
zh: 于一沙见世界，于一花见天堂。
author: William Blake

text: Energy is eternal delight.
zh: 能量是永恒的喜悦。
author: William Blake

text: No bird soars too high if he soars with his own wings.
zh: 凭自己的翅膀高飞，没有鸟飞得太高。
author: William Blake

text: What is now proved was once only imagined.
zh: 今日已证之事，昔日为想象。
author: William Blake

text: If Winter comes, can Spring be far behind?
zh: 冬天来了，春天还会远吗？
author: Percy Bysshe Shelley

text: Fear not for the future, weep not for the past.
zh: 不为将来惧，不为往昔泣。
author: Percy Bysshe Shelley

text: Love withers under constraint; its very essence is liberty.
zh: 爱在束缚下凋萎，其本质正是自由。
author: Percy Bysshe Shelley

text: Poetry is the record of the best and happiest moments of the best and happiest minds.
zh: 诗歌是最美心灵最幸福时刻的记录。
author: Percy Bysshe Shelley

text: Keep your face always toward the sunshine - and shadows will fall behind you.
zh: 永远面朝阳光，阴影便会落在身后。
author: Walt Whitman

text: The powerful play goes on, and you may contribute a verse.
zh: 壮丽的戏剧继续上演，你也可献上一行诗。
author: Walt Whitman

text: I am large, I contain multitudes.
zh: 我胸怀广阔，我包罗万象。
author: Walt Whitman

text: Re-examine all you have been told. Dismiss that which insults your soul.
zh: 重审你听来的一切，抛弃那侮辱你灵魂之说。
author: Walt Whitman

text: Rest is not quitting the fight. Rest is the part of the fight you're not yet strong enough to see.
zh: 休息不是退出战斗，而是你尚未强大到能看清的战斗的一部分。
author: Walt Whitman

text: The earth is rude and incomprehensible at first; be not discouraged, keep on, there are divine things well enveloped.
zh: 大地起初粗粝难解，别气馁，继续前行，神圣之物正被妥善包裹。
author: Walt Whitman

text: Hope is the thing with feathers that perches in the soul.
zh: 希望是栖于灵魂、生有羽毛之物。
author: Emily Dickinson

text: Forever is composed of nows.
zh: 永远由无数个现在组成。
author: Emily Dickinson

text: We never know how high we are till we are called to rise.
zh: 不到被召唤奋起之时，我们不知自己能有多高。
author: Emily Dickinson

text: Dwell in possibility.
zh: 栖居于可能之中。
author: Emily Dickinson

text: Success is counted sweetest by those who ne'er succeed.
zh: 成功之甘，未曾成功者尝得最浓。
author: Emily Dickinson

text: Not knowing when the dawn will come, I open every door.
zh: 不知黎明何时至，我敞开每一扇门。
author: Emily Dickinson

text: Don't judge each day by the harvest you reap but by the seeds you plant.
zh: 勿以收成评判每一天，而以你播下的种子。
author: Robert Louis Stevenson

text: Make the most of the best and the least of the worst.
zh: 善处最佳，淡看最劣。
author: Robert Louis Stevenson

text: Keep your fears to yourself, but share your courage.
zh: 恐惧留给自己，勇气与人分享。
author: Robert Louis Stevenson

text: To travel hopefully is a better thing than to arrive.
zh: 怀抱希望地旅行，胜于抵达。
author: Robert Louis Stevenson

text: It is never too late to be what you might have been.
zh: 成为你本可成为的人，永不为迟。
author: George Eliot

text: What do we live for, if not to make life less difficult for each other?
zh: 若不能让彼此生活稍易，我们活着何为？
author: George Eliot

text: Blessed is the influence of one true, loving human soul on another.
zh: 一个真诚、有爱之魂对另一个的影响，是蒙福的。
author: George Eliot

text: Our sweetest songs are those that tell of saddest thought.
zh: 我们最甜美的歌，诉说的是最哀伤的思绪。
author: George Eliot

text: The man without a purpose is a ship without a rudder.
zh: 没有目标的人，是缺舵之船。
author: Thomas Carlyle

text: No pressure, no diamond.
zh: 无压力，无钻石。
author: Thomas Carlyle

text: He who has health has hope; and he who has hope has everything.
zh: 有健康者有希望；有希望者拥有一切。
author: Thomas Carlyle

text: Silence is the element in which great things fashion themselves together.
zh: 沉默是伟大事物彼此成形的元素。
author: Thomas Carlyle

text: The highest reward for a person's toil is not what they get for it, but what they become by it.
zh: 劳作最高回报不在所得，而在所成。
author: John Ruskin

text: Quality is never an accident. It is always the result of intelligent effort.
zh: 品质从非偶然，必是明智努力之果。
author: John Ruskin

text: When love and skill work together, expect a masterpiece.
zh: 当爱与技巧携手，杰作可期。
author: John Ruskin

text: The first wealth is health.
zh: 健康是第一笔财富。
author: John Ruskin

text: It is not so much our friends' help that helps us, as the confidence of their help.
zh: 与其说朋友的帮助助我们，不如说对他们会相助的信心助我们。
author: Epicurus

text: The greater the difficulty, the more the glory in surmounting it.
zh: 困难愈大，克服它的荣光愈盛。
author: Epicurus

text: Do not spoil what you have by desiring what you have not.
zh: 别因觊觎未得之物，糟蹋了已有之物。
author: Epicurus

text: Freedom is the oxygen of the soul.
zh: 自由是灵魂之氧。
author: Epicurus
